info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Features:  Paging Group API
Read the List of Paging Groups

params.name: orgId
params.description: List paging groups for this organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of objects returned to this maximum count. Default is 2000

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching objects. Default is 0

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return only paging groups with matching location ID. Default is all locations

params.name: name
params.description: Return only paging groups with the matching name.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Return only paging groups with matching primary phone number or extension.

items.docs:
List all Paging Groups for the organization.

Group Paging allows a person to place a one-way call or group page to up to 75 people and/or workspaces by
dialing a number or extension assigned to a specific paging group. The Group Paging service makes a simultaneous call to all the assigned targets.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Create the paging group for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Create the paging group for this organization.

items.docs:
Create a new Paging Group for the given location.

Group Paging allows a one-way call or group page to up to 75 people, workspaces and virtual lines by
dialing a number or extension assigned to a specific paging group. The Group Paging service makes a simultaneous call to all the assigned targets.

Creating a paging group requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.

info.name: Get Paging Group Primary Available Phone Numbers

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of phone numbers for this location within the given organization. The maximum length is 36.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List numbers for this organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of phone numbers returned to this maximum count. The default is 2000.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching phone numbers. The default is 0.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Filter phone numbers based on the comma-separated list provided in the `phoneNumber` array.

items.docs:
List the service and standard PSTN numbers that are available to be assigned as the paging group's primary phone number.
These numbers are associated with the location specified in the request URL, can be active or inactive, and are unassigned.

The available numbers APIs help identify candidate numbers and their owning entities to simplify the assignment or association of these numbers to members or features.

Retrieving this list requires a full, read-only or location administrator auth token
